title: Coarse navigation and routing
purpose: Compute deterministic routes from the current pose to the destination zone/aisle/shelf and track progress.
architecturalScope: Navigation bounded context. PathPlanner over StoreMap. Deterministic A*/Dijkstra; no learned components in the critical path.
domainContext: Destination, Route, NavigationInstruction, NavigationSession aggregate. Emits DestinationResolved, NavigationPaused, NavigationResumed.

milestones.title: Deterministic routing core
milestones.description: A* over the StoreMap graph with unit tests on synthetic maps.

milestones.title: Progress tracking and re-planning
milestones.description: Track progress and re-plan on pose updates.

tasks.title: Define PathPlanner port and Route types
acceptanceCriteria: Route decisions are unit-testable without hardware.

tasks.title: Implement A* planner
acceptanceCriteria: Route length within 1.3x optimal on test graphs.

tasks.title: Implement progress tracking and re-planning
acceptanceCriteria: Re-planning triggered on deviation or localization jump.
Routing is deterministic for identical inputs.
Unreachable or stale-map cases are handled explicitly, not by guessing.

risks.mitigation: Re-plan on pose updates and expose localization confidence to guidance.

safetyImplications: Routing must not imply obstacle-free travel; guidance always defers to safety warnings.
accessibilityImplications: The planner only produces structured instructions; a separate generator makes them accessible.
privacyImplications: Routes are computed from the map and ephemeral pose; no route history is stored.
verificationRequirements: Property test: no route through non-traversable edges.
